It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1987 and earlier in the [[Batasang Pambansa]] from 1984 to 1986.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 9, 2021}} Pasay first elected a single representative city-wide [[at-large]] for the [[Regular Batasang Pambansa]] following the [[1984 Philippine constitutional plebiscite]] that amended the 1973 constitution and abolished the regional at-large assembly districts.{{cite PH act|chamber=PP|number=2332|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1984/02/01/proclamation-no-2332-s-1984/ |title=Proclaiming the Ratification in the Plebiscite of January 27, 1984, of the Amendments to the Constitution Embodied in Batasang Pambansa Resolutions Nos. 104, 105, 110, 111, 112 and 113 |date=February 1, 1984 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=June 30, 2023}} Before 1973, the city was represented in the [[List of legislatures of the Philippines|national legislatures]] as part of [[Rizal's 1st congressional district|Rizal's 1st]] and [[Rizal's at-large congressional district|at-large]] districts and [[Manila's at-large congressional district|Manila's at-large]] district. The district was re-created on February 2, 1987 following the ratification of the [[Constitution of the Philippines|1987 constitution]] that restored the House of Representatives.{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 9, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Tony Calixto|Antonino G. Calixto]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 9, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Batasang
